// Reset zeros the fields of ResetableStruct; safe to call on a nil receiver.
func (r *ResetableStruct) Reset() {
	if r == nil {
		return
	}
	r.i = 0
	r.str = ""
	r.flag = false
	if r.strP != nil {
		*r.strP = ""
	}
	r.s = r.s[:0]
	clear(r.m)
	if r.child != nil {
		r.child.Reset()
	}
}

// Reset zeros the fields of WithExternal; safe to call on a nil receiver.
func (w *WithExternal) Reset() {
	if w == nil {
		return
	}
	if w.helper != nil {
		w.helper.Reset()
	}
	w.value.Reset()
}
